name: Next.js 15 + Prisma + PostgreSQL
note: Each task runs a real command. Prisma and the session are mocked at the module boundary so the suite runs offline with no PostgreSQL; what is under test is the Server Action logic itself. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost from the kit files.

eval_tasks.title: Zod schemas reject client-supplied tenancy
eval_tasks.instruction: Client payload schemas must be strict and must not accept tenantId or userId; those belong to the session.
assertions: tenantId in the payload is rejected rather than silently stripped
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && npx vitest run tests/schema.test.ts

eval_tasks.title: Task schema enum and persist shape
eval_tasks.instruction: Task input must validate its status enum, require a projectId, and require a server-stamped tenantId at persist time.
assertions: an out-of-range status enum is rejected
the default status is applied when omitted
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && npx vitest run tests/actions.test.ts

eval_tasks.title: Declared security controls hold under test
eval_tasks.instruction: Run the suite covering the controls named in security/checks.json: mass assignment, tenant isolation, authentication and input validation.
assertions: SEC-12: smuggled tenantId, userId and unknown keys are all rejected
SEC-12: the tenant written to the database comes from the session, never the payload
SEC-05: create, list and read are scoped by the session tenant
SEC-05: a foreign project id reads as missing, not forbidden
SEC-05: a task cannot be attached to a project outside the caller tenant
auth: unauthenticated calls throw and never reach the database
SEC-04: validation failure short-circuits before any write
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && npx vitest run tests/security.test.ts

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete schema, action and security suite must pass with no failures.
